Apply the PSV position calibration

Source: R/psr.R
apply_psv_calibration.Rd

Multiplies psv (and osv/dsv when present, so osv + dsv == psv is preserved) by that player's position factor.

Usage

apply_psv_calibration(
  psv_dt,
  position_col = "pos_grp",
  calibration = load_psv_calibration()
)

Arguments

psv_dt

A data.frame/data.table with psv and a position column.

position_col

Name of the resolved-position column. Default "pos_grp"; "primary_position" and "position" are used as fallbacks when present.

calibration

Calibration table; defaults to load_psv_calibration.

Value

psv_dt with psv (and osv/dsv) scaled, and an attribute panna_psv_calibrated = TRUE.
